nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Brightening Exfoliating Daily Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily or congested T-zone say the cleanser controls congestion and helps clear stubborn breakouts, including one whose partner's very oily skin became pimple-free with regular use.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry say it sloughs away flaky patches without stripping and eased dryness during perimenopause for one long-time user, though a few who found the reformulated version drying say it left dry skin feeling worse than before.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it cleans an oily T-zone while still gently exfoliating drier areas of the same face.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who call their skin sensitive find the exfoliating beads gentle enough for daily or a few-times-weekly use without redness, though a handful say the current formula feels too harsh or drying for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 60s, including one navigating perimenopause, report brighter, less dull-looking skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her late 40s going through perimenopause credits the cleanser with easing dry, dull skin, and another says acquaintances told her she looked younger after using it regularly.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the current formula dries out their skin or is less moisturizing than the previous version, in some cases badly enough that they stopped using it daily; others, including one in a very dry winter climate, report it leaves skin soft and refreshed rather than dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report the cleanser leaves their face calm and smooth rather than red or blotchy, with no irritation despite regular use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report a visible lightening of dark spots and hyperpigmentation after weeks to months of regular use; one credits part of the effect to pairing it with a separate dark-spot serum.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some who describe themselves as acne-prone or previously affected by cystic acne, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin with continued use, and one says a longstanding blackhead cleared after a single use; no reviewer in this set reports new breakouts caused by the product.

aspects.libelle: Cap or pump breaks, clogs, or gets messy
Reformulation disappoints fans of the discontinued original
Small amount needed, bottle lasts for months
Lathers into a light foam during use
Exfoliating beads can migrate into eyes while rinsing

extraits.titre: Please bring back the old formula!!
extraits.texte: Please, please bring back the old formula! I love Kiehl's and this was favorite face wash. The texture is completely different now and the product does not leave my face feeling as clean as the previous product did. It is also not as moisturizing as the old formula. My face feels extremely dry after using the new product.

extraits.titre: Please please bring back the old cleanser ASAP!
extraits.texte: The original cleanser worked wonders and I was upset to find out it has been replaced. The new version is terrible- harsh on my sensitive skin. Why try to reinvent something that worked so well before??? It?s pretty obvious that this new formula is a bust from all the other negative reviews, so please do something NOW to save your loyal kiehls customers from jumping ship to another brand and BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL CLEANSER ALREADY PLEASE!!!

extraits.titre: The Best Cleanser for Combo/Oily/Congested Skin
extraits.texte: Ok people...I've honestly never tried the original formula mentioned in other reviews, but this stuff is amazing! I'm 50 and I have struggled with oily T-zone, acne/cystic acne for years and finally have clear skin! I've tried every cleanser (admitted skin care addiction) and while I thought I found results with other cleansers, it would only be temporary. My 20 year old daughter swears by it! Her skin has cleared and she is able to go foundation free with flawless skin. We've been using for over two years. It has pearlstone that acts as a gentle scrub unclogging pores, leaving your skin soft and smooth. Although its a little pricey, a dime/nickel size amount will clean your entire face and neck, so a tube lasts about 3-4 mos. Love this product!

extraits.titre: it's the face cleaner i've been looking for.
extraits.texte: i never tried the prior formulation, so i can't compare. but for me, this is perhaps my perfect face cleanser. it foams just the right amount. has just the right amount of exfoliating ingredients so that it feels properly cleansed but not overly so. my skin always looks bright and fresh after i use it. and, as someone who is 48, with aging skin, who has hit perimenopause, it has helped immensely with my dry skin. it was getting to the point where i was having so much dead skin on my cheeks and chin that if i rubbed my face, skin would come off on my fingers. no more since using this product. and my skin looks less dull and ragged.

extraits.titre: This product blows away my previous cleanser!
extraits.texte: I feel so bad for the folks who had great experiences with the prior product. I?m fairly new to the Kiehl?s product line, but I have to say that I absolutely love this product! My skin is very sensitive, so I?ve shelled out a lot of cash over the years trying various products, and the product I used (most recently) before this one cost more than twice as much and didn?t work half as well. Not only does this product clean my skin without creating a red, splotchy face, but it really does brighten my skin...to the point where I bumped into some old friends who told me that I look much younger! Needless to say, I?m a huge fan of this cleanser! To those of you who may not be as enamored, hang in there and keep trying some other Kiehl?s options!
I've been using this for two years and nothing makes my face feel as fresh and clean. I see a noticeable difference in the texture and appearance of my skin, including a lightening of dark spots!

My complexion has never looked better. I have tried so many washes and exfoliating products over the years and this has yielded the best results. I never have breakouts anymore also. I if I feel a flare up coming, I just stick with my routine using this every evening when I wash my face and it keeps blemishes away. Thank you Kiehls for making this highly effective cleanser! My skin just looks cleaner- and to the title of the product - brighter~~
